general.simpleModeHint: Basic calendar: Timeline, schedule, Items, Assistant, and Notifications — no Tasks page
general.weatherLocationRequired: Enter a location name, or choose Follow system
general.collectorRestartDescription: Restarts the message collector and reconnects all source adapters. Does not delete the database or account sessions.
general.collectorRestartConfirmBody: This will disconnect and reconnect all source adapters (Telegram, Discord, Email, RSS, etc.). Messages and account data are not deleted.
general.appVersionHelp: Shared frontend/backend semver; DEV prefix in dev.
general.databaseVersionHelp: Public schema SemVer; mismatched stamp requires a reset.

debug.traceVerboseHelp: When on, each message-batch analysis writes a trace to Settings → Logs (hidden by default — enable “Show analysis traces”). No full LLM bodies; unused by agent / recurring. Saves immediately.
debug.traceVerboseHint: Writes batch traces to Settings → Logs

theme.bgQuotaExceeded: Not enough localStorage space to save the background image
theme.bgImageHelp: Available on every theme. A photo background pauses page texture until cleared.
theme.bgModeHelp: None keeps the theme motif. Custom uses an uploaded photo. Focal uses Bing’s daily image (via the local server).
theme.bgModeFocalHelp: Fetches Bing wallpapers through the app server (no API key). Refresh cycles recent days (today → yesterday → …). Offline: last successful image, or motif if none cached.
theme.focalFetchFailed: Could not load today’s focal image. Showing motif (or last cached image if available).
theme.focalRefreshHelp: Refresh loads the next recent Bing day (idx 0–7). Auto-refresh (device-local) advances on that interval when this tab is visible.
theme.colorOpacityHelp: Each swatch has its own color and opacity. Lowering card opacity also softens glass menus.
theme.resetPersonalizationHelp: Clears color, opacity, and texture overrides for this theme. Does not remove a custom background image.

retention.helpAnalysis: Includes Intel events and time planning (the same event data). Default 0 = keep forever.
retention.helpAppLogs: Shorter by default; set to 0 to disable auto cleanup.
retention.helpUserEvents: Calendar / manual / assistant one-off events. Default 0 = keep forever.
retention.invalid: Retention days must be 0 or a positive integer (0 = disable auto cleanup)
retention.description: Each data type has its own retention days; set to 0 to disable cleanup for that type. A background job runs daily, or use “Run now” below. Deleting old messages does not cascade-delete completed analysis results.

data.retentionCleanupDescription: Runs a cleanup pass immediately using the current retention days, and returns the deleted counts per category. Does not restart the service.
data.retentionRunConfirmBody: This deletes expired messages, analysis results, leaderboard rows, logs, and user events per the current retention days. This cannot be undone.
data.runtimeResetDescription: Deletes all local state (database, admin account, secret.key, Desktop connection.json, device/Telegram sessions, and frontend cache), relaunches Desktop / reloads the page, and opens first-run setup.
data.runtimeResetConfirmBody: This deletes the database, secret.key, connection.json, admin account, account sessions, and frontend cache, then relaunches into first-run setup. This cannot be undone.

liaison.title: Account manager (A2A)
liaison.body: `POST /api/v1/a2a/agent`: one-shot natural-language assign. Needs a full key and an AI profile.

No custom events schema for third-party agents

deepLink.title: Calendar link
deepLink.body: Desktop only: `intelligencemonitor://` and `.ics`, then confirm to add to the calendar.

capabilities: `intelligencemonitor://calendar/import?url=…` — fetch remote ICS (http/https)

Or open a `.ics` file from the OS (same confirmation dialog)

staff.intro: Front-line: Assistant and Task advisor. Back-office: Leaderboard analyst, Intel task analyst, and Project Manager (invoked by analysis tasks). Plus an Account manager for external systems (A2A; same team as the assistant; no chat with you).
staff.backofficeNote: Back-office staff are invoked by analysis tasks; they don’t appear in chat.
staff.avatarTooLarge: Image is still too large after compression. Try a smaller file.
staff.historyMaxMessagesHelp: Max recent dialogue messages sent to the model (system prompt excluded from the count). Older turns are omitted when exceeded; the UI transcript stays complete. Default 40.
staff.historyMaxCharsHelp: Approx. max characters for the model-facing history (including the system prompt). Older turns are omitted when exceeded. Default 48000.

assistant.summary: A multi-turn Agent that can look up data, manage schedules, or track inventory items when needed.
capabilities: Answer questions about local intel, schedules, and items in natural language
Search collected messages; look up analysis events
List / create / update / delete user events and recurring (RRULE) tasks
List / create / update trackable items (qty / unit; money on purchase/effective linked calendars; expiry via linked calendar — never invent dates)
Optionally search the web when enabled in settings
Works in the assistant popup and full assistant page; voice in/out optional

taskEditor.summary: Chats beside new/edit task forms to help fill settings (not an Agent).
capabilities: Suggest task name and description from what you want to monitor
Suggest task type (leaderboard / intel / project manager / recurring) and prompt direction
Help with time range, schedule, and related fields
Only configures tasks—does not analyze messages or call tools

leaderboard.summary: Back-office: batch-processes messages into trending topics.
capabilities: Extract discussion topics from a message batch
Score relevance/heat and summarize topics
Update the leaderboard for the leaderboard page
No chat UI; triggered by schedules or manual task runs

intel_event.summary: Back-office: extracts trackable intel and schedule events (including time-inference templates).
capabilities: Extract intel, meetings, activities, deadlines, and similar events
Fill time, place, and people when possible (including relative times)
Results appear in intel / map / timeline views
No chat UI; triggered by schedules or manual task runs

agent.summary: Configurable back-office Project Manager: project reconcile or web scout by trigger/output policy; details on the Project Manager task page.
capabilities: Triggers: message-cursor drain, message threshold, or pure schedule (cursor drain cannot also output analysis events)
Per-task: calendar read/write, web search; optional items read (expiry / inventory)
Cannot add or change items (only Assistant and Account manager can write items)
Outputs may write agent calendar events and/or analysis events
No chat UI; driven by the Project Manager task schedule (prefer hourly)

liaison.name: Account manager
liaison.summary: External agent: third parties assign work in natural language—no custom API schema. Doesn’t chat with you.
capabilities: Shares the assistant’s LLM and tools (messages / intel / calendar / items; different system prompt)
Single-shot reply; history kept by the caller if needed
Keys and examples under Settings → External interfaces → A2A
